content.text: Dilute sulfuric acid and lead(II) bromide are electrolysed separately.

rows: Colourless gases are produced when dilute sulfuric acid is electrolysed.
Lead(II) bromide can be electrolysed when molten.
Lead is formed at the positive electrode when lead(II) bromide is electrolysed.
Sulfate ions are produced at the negative electrode when dilute sulfuric acid is electrolysed.
